exposure: patient factors (age, sex, comorbidity score, ASA physical status score)
outcome: Days Alive and At Home during the 30 days following surgery (DAH30)
cohort: The study included 126,788 adults (median age 62 years) admitted for elective or emergency inpatient surgery with anaesthesia covered by private health insurance in Australia.
finding: DAH30 had a moderate inverse association with total hospital costs and declined with increasing age, comorbidity score, ASA physical status score, surgical severity and duration, and was lower for women.
